summary: Aditya Shrikant Gangwar is a B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering student at Ajay Kumar Garg Engineering College (expected graduation June 2026). His resume highlights projects such as an Airbnb Clone, Spotify Clone Backend, and Weather App, alongside technical skills in Java, JavaScript, React.js, Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, and MySQL. He has also completed an internship with IBM SkillsBuild and apprenticeship training at Indian Oil Corporation Limited.

projects.name: Airbnb Clone (Full Stack)
strengths: Covers full-stack implementation with database and authentication
Clear feature breakdown using bullet points
weaknesses: Is a clone application with low uniqueness
Lacks quantified impact or user metrics
improvements: Add advanced features like payment gateway integration or search filtering optimizations

projects.name: Spotify Clone Backend
strengths: Focuses on backend architecture, role-based access control, and MVC pattern
Clear explanation of middleware and file upload integration
weaknesses: Is a clone application lacking originality
No performance benchmarks or testing metrics provided
improvements: Implement audio streaming optimization or caching layers

projects.name: Weather App
strengths: Demonstrates API integration and React hooks usage
Concise bullet points detailing user input handling
weaknesses: Common beginner project with very low uniqueness
Lacks advanced state management or error boundaries
improvements: Add historical weather charts or location autocomplete features

issues.title: Missing Professional Summary
issues.problem: The resume lacks a professional summary section at the top.
issues.reason: Recruiters prefer a brief introductory paragraph highlighting career goals and core competencies.
issues.fix: Add a short professional summary section below the contact information.

issues.title: Spelling Error in Extracurricular
issues.problem: The word 'Apperentice' is misspelled under the Indian Oil Corporation Limited entry.
issues.reason: Spelling mistakes can negatively impact the professional impression of the resume.

issues.title: Missing Quantified Achievements
issues.problem: None of the project or internship bullet points contain metrics or numbers.
issues.reason: Quantifying achievements helps demonstrate the scale and impact of the work performed.
issues.fix: Add metrics where applicable, such as API response times, user base size, or number of components built.

issues.title: Punctuation Spacing Inconsistency
issues.problem: Extra spaces exist before periods in some bullet points (e.g., in the IBM internship section).
issues.reason: Inconsistent spacing affects the visual polish of the resume.
issues.fix: Remove spaces preceding terminal periods in bullet points.

strengths: Clean and well-organized layout with standard section headings
Clear demarcation of technologies used across individual projects
Good coverage of fundamental computer science subjects and technical skills
Inclusion of both academic education and practical project/internship experience
